case_number: 2024 INSC 1022; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 14804 OF 2024 (arising out of SLP (C) No. 18743 of 2022)
summary: Specific performance of sale agreement; deceased vendor left limited property; High Court reversed trial court citing potential hardship on respondents as homeless heirs; trial court granted decree for sale and possession; legal standard: discretion under S.20 Specific Relief Act, 1963; hardship not foreseeable at time of contract; inadequacy of consideration alone insufficient; appeal allowed to restore trial court's specific performance decree with payment of balance consideration.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court's judgment quashed; trial court decree for specific performance restored; respondents directed to execute sale deed upon payment of Rs.13,50,000; High Court's order for refund of earnest money set aside.
